description: Proposal of Application Notice: 'Data centre complex including data halls, substation, new road access, balancing pond, security, associated development, landscaping, new trees, wildflower meadow (major application)' at Land at Purroch Farm, Mauchline Road, Hurlford.
decision_notes: The council's Idox portal (via PlanIt mirror) records the outcome as 'Approved with Conditions' (decided 2025-11-25, delegated) — for a PAN this denotes acceptance of the notice/consultation approach, not planning permission. A formal (major) planning application can follow no earlier than 12 weeks after the PAN.
